Gram Panchayat Kanakpur vs Shankar Ji Mahila Swa - Sahayata 
Samuh ... on 30 September, 2024
 1/2
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh At Bilaspur
 Fa No. 167 of 2024
Gram Panchayat Kanakpur versus Shankar Ji Mahila Swa
 - Sahayata Samuh Village - Kanakpur
 Order Sheet
30/09/2024 Mr. Rahul Mishra, counsel for the appellants. 
 Mr. T.R. Chandrakar, counsel for respondent No.1. 
Mr. Lav Sharma, Pl for the State/respondents No.2 to 6.  Perusal of the cause title of the First Appeal would show that the particulars of defendant No.7/respondent No.5 have not been mentioned properly as per the cause list of the judgment of the Court below. 
Learned counsel for the appellants prays for time to file suitable application for such amendment. 
When a query has been put to the counsel for the appellants as to how much admissible claim of respondent No.1/plaintiff is pending consideration before the authorities, he prays for time to seek instructions in this regard. 
Respondent No.6 is directed to hold a fact finding enquiry with regard to the fact as to whether the procedure for the subject Scheme is being followed properly by the parties or not. In the Enquiry Body of the Preliminary Enquiry, one of the members shall consist of the CEO District Panchayat,
Balrampur, and the said enquiry shall be completed within a period of 45 days from the date of passing of this order. 
The Collector shall ensure that in the Mid-day Meal programme of the concerned District, the supplier of the food business is holding a required license under the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006. Further, in the instant matter, if any norms have been found to be breached, the concerned Authority is directed to apprise this Court as to what action has been initiated by them in this respect.
